unit.evidence: 53 unit cases: 30 validator cases including the redaction and secret families, 9 cross-tool validation state cases, 9 quality evidence cases, 3 Claude adapter contract cases, and 2 SETUP-00 checklist and documentation link cases.

integration.evidence: 22 isolated Git and subprocess cases: 4 checkpoint lifecycle and boundary cases, 8 delta inventory cases, 6 detached-HEAD cases, 2 finalization ledger cases, and 2 historical checkpoint compatibility cases against clean clones of the sealed tags.

e2e.evidence: No functional runtime exists in SETUP-00, so runtime end-to-end testing is not applicable. The unauthenticated Claude Code CLI cold start remains blocked and is not counted as evidence.
